description: Masters of a light Starfield plugin added, sorted and cleaned again: Constellation.esm loaded as Sf33Light.esm (not an official module, so it can be edited) takes the light module OldMars.esm as a master and loses it again, so every FormID of the file is rewritten twice with the complex (small/light) FileIDs of Starfield: the file's own records move from light slot 0 to 1 and back, and the copied records' references move with them. A PERK with a perk activity JSON (its `ATAV` text becomes the virtual `NULL` tree the reference index reads) is copied as a new record too, so the copy's ATAV text and its FormIDs are written back by the same code. The file must end with the bytes it started from. The copied PERK [FE00104C] is shown (records.compare, the GUI's JumpTo) before the masters update, so its virtual tree is built from the copied ATAV text then: without it the update builds the tree of the record the copy collapsed, and the release writes the ATAV JSON from that half-built tree, every Data value at its default (UPSTREAM-BUG, issue #73: the port keeps the text, so the sequence shows the record first and both sides end with the copied text).
